findings.title: Do not disable conditional passkeys when no user is selected
findings.body: This helper returns false whenever `context.getUser()` is null, so the initial login form never calls `webauthnAuth.fillContextForm()` and does not expose conditional passkey authentication. That is the normal state before a user enters a username, and it breaks discoverable-passkey login in the username/password flow; the same guard also prevents the passkey UI from being restored after an invalid-username error clears the user.
